resolution.note: verify --id clears the named row before grading and refuses an unknown id; --units names the unit directory; CLI test re-grades a recorded drop row in bubblewrap

title: screening verify --id re-grades a recorded unit instead of skipping it with exit 0
body:
`node evals/units/screening.ts verify --id <id>` silently skips a unit whose manifest row already has `verification` and still prints `units: N verified` with exit 0, so a targeted re-verify (t-k7gv1wt, after a sandbox change) runs nothing and looks green.
Acceptance: `verify --id <id>` re-verifies that unit even when recorded (or `--force`), and prints which ids it graded; a test asserts a recorded row is re-graded.
Proof: node --test test/evals/screening-units.test.ts exits 0 with a recorded-row re-grade test
